uncertainties.detail: Identity confidence is 18. The exact vessel, hull, former names and transaction sequence are clear, but the owner record contains no name and public sources disclose none. Canadian nationality and residence appear only in the authoritative placeholder and do not narrow the population enough to identify a person.

Wave is conclusively the 2024 Benetti Oasis 40M hull BO116, formerly Orenda and Contigo. YachtBuyer reports 385 GT, SuperYacht Times reports 386 GT and the authoritative input reports 385 tonnes; the shared 40.8-metre length, build year, hull sequence, design and former names make this a minor measurement discrepancy.

Orenda sold in October 2024 and became Contigo under an unnamed California entrepreneur. It entered the market again in February 2025 and sold in December 2025 to an anonymous buyer represented by breezeYachting.swiss. The current Wave name appears after that second resale, making the later unnamed buyer the relevant identity target.

No current brokerage, sale, registry, yacht-directory or charter source located in this pass describes the December 2025 buyer as Canadian. The upstream nationality and residence may be accurate private intelligence, but they cannot be independently verified or used to select among Canadian businesspeople.

Cornelius Kistler of breezeYachting.swiss introduced the December 2025 buyer. That brokerage relationship does not establish the buyer's nationality, residence, company or identity, and no client name was published in the official sale announcement.

Wave is currently offered for charter, but a yacht's commercial registration or charter availability does not identify its beneficial owner or establish the owner's wealth industry. Charter managers, captains and brokers are not treated as owner candidates.

With no personal name, Forbes-first research could only combine the vessel's current and former names, builder, model and Canadian placeholder. No Forbes result disclosed an owner, and no personal Forbes profile can be evaluated.

Search results surfaced owners of other Benetti Oasis 40M yachts, including Tim Ciasulli and Rich Kracum. They attach to different hulls and national contexts and are excluded. The unnamed California owner described before the December 2025 resale is also historical, not the current Wave owner.
